cv.profile: I am looking for my first software role in a team where I can contribute and learn. I understand code, but I do not yet write it independently. I use Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and Codex to turn scoped tasks into working implementations, then run the result, test its behaviour and work through problems. I have used Claude for around 18 months and continue to improve both my coding fundamentals and my use of AI. I am available for full-time work alongside online studies.

projects.name: API Contract Guard
projects.detail: A bounded command-line tool for comparing a defined OpenAPI subset. I set the supported change categories, expected reports and failure boundaries, then reviewed the AI-assisted implementation and test cases. It covers five documented breaking-change categories and fails closed outside scope.

projects.name: EvidenceDesk
projects.meta: React · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Redis · Synthetic data
projects.detail: A document-review prototype that links answers to supporting pages and can abstain when evidence is missing. Recall@5 reached 100% on 25 of 25 answerable synthetic cases; the wider answer evaluation did not pass (36% accuracy and 45.67% extraction F1), so the limit remains visible.

projects.name: Synthevia
projects.meta: React · TypeScript · FastAPI · SQLite · Public project page
projects.detail: A learning and research workspace built with AI assistance. Its public project page presents the product and synthetic examples. The separate local code sample connects a React interface to a FastAPI backend and SQLite data; it uses fictional data and external services are not connected.

letter.subject: Open application · Junior software / backend / applied AI
paragraphs: I am looking for my first role in software development or applied AI. I started in business studies, then became interested in building software through my own projects. I would like to take that work further in a team where I can learn from experienced developers.

I understand code, but I do not yet write it independently. I use Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and Codex to work through scoped implementation tasks, then run the result and test its behaviour. I have used Claude for around 18 months and keep improving my coding fundamentals alongside my use of AI.

My portfolio includes API Contract Guard, a TypeScript tool with 102 recorded local tests, and EvidenceDesk, a document-review prototype with source citations. EvidenceDesk also has an answer evaluation that did not pass, which is documented in the repository. Synthevia has a public project page and a separate local React, FastAPI and SQLite sample using fictional data. The portfolio also presents five public project demos. These personal projects give us something concrete to discuss.

I am available for full-time work and have been admitted to OPIT's online BSc (Hons) Computer Science, September 2026 intake. Classes begin on 21 September, and I plan to study alongside work. I would value clear expectations, regular code review and the chance to contribute while learning.
I would be glad to walk you through one of my projects, explain how I built it and discuss whether my current level fits what your team needs.
